paite: Hiaite ahi uh huai gam kunipipate, Israel santen ahihman ua, agam uh Jordan lui gal, nisuahna lam gamte, Arnon Phaizang a pan Hermon tang tan, suahlam pang a Arabah tengteng toh aneihsak uh kumpipate:
heading: Mosi In Azoh Kumpipate

paite: Amorte kumpipa Sihon, Heshbon a teng in Arnon Phaizang pang a om Aroer a pan vai ahawm a, phaizang laitak a khopite, Ammon suante gamgi Jabok lui pha in Gilead gam kimkhat tung ah vai ahawm hi.
Suahlam ah Arabah ah Kineroth Tuipi tan in ahi a; suahlam ah Beth-jeshimoth hohna lampı lam ah Arabah Tuipi, Chi Tuipi tan in ahi a; simlam ah Pisgah tang nuai pha in ahi.
Astaroth leh Edrei a om Rephaim nam khosuaksunte lak ah Bashan kumpipa Og in vai ahawm hi.
Amah Hermon tang, Salkah khua leh Bashan tengteng, Geshurte leh Maakathte gamgi pha leh Heshbon kumpipa Sihon gamgi chiang Gilead gam kimkhat pha in vai ahawm hi.
TOUPA sikha Mosi leh Israel suante'n huaite athat ua; TOUPA sikha Mosi in Reuben chite, Gad chite, Manasseh nam kimkhatte agouluah ding un ahawm hi.

Hiai gam kumpipate ahi, Joshua leh Israel suante'n Jordan lui gal tumlam pang a, athahte uh, Lebanon Phaizang Baal-gad a pan Seir tang suntou Halak tang pha in. Joshua in Israel suante akikhendan bang zel un, huai gam agouluah ding un ape chiatta hi.
